## Ctx.renderEditPhotoGroup() method

Replaces the current message with a photo media group.

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderEditPhotoGroup(data?: ITData | null, AGBaseId?: string | null, options?: ITOptReplyPhoto | null): Promise<(grammy_types.Message.PhotoMessage | grammy_types.Message.VideoMessage | grammy_types.Message.AudioMessage | grammy_types.Message.DocumentMessage | grammy_types.Message.LivePhotoMessage)[]>;
```

The sent media group message object.

## Remarks

Deletes the original message and sends a new media group via `replyMediaGroup`<!-- -->. Useful when the template uses pipe-delimited `src` values.

  await this.renderEditPhotoGroup()
